Expected item scores against the digital measure

Source: R/plots.R
plot_expected_scores.Rd

Structural and probabilistic crosswalks, estimated (solid) and true (dashed, columns ending in `_true`), with a rug of the observed measure.

Usage

plot_expected_scores(
  cw,
  sqi,
  items = paste0("C", 1:7),
  x_label = "Actigraphy SQI (digital measure)"
)

Arguments

cw

crosswalk table from [crosswalk()] with `_true` columns added

sqi

observed digital measure

items

item names

x_label

x-axis title
